udt_struct_v0.doc: Terms the payer signs. The actual settled amount is not part of the terms;\nit is supplied (and signed) by the facilitator at settlement time.
udt_struct_v0.name: SettlementTerms

fields.doc: Token contract (SEP-41) used for the payment.
fields.name: asset

fields.doc: Last ledger (inclusive) at which settlement is allowed; also used as\nthe expiration ledger of the inline token approval.
fields.name: deadline_ledger

fields.doc: Account allowed to choose the actual amount and submit settlement.
fields.name: facilitator

fields.doc: Upper bound on the settled amount, in the token's atomic units.
fields.name: max_amount

fields.doc: Account that receives the settled amount.
fields.name: pay_to

fields.doc: First ledger (inclusive) at which settlement is allowed.
fields.name: valid_after_ledger

function_v0.doc:
Settles `actual_amount` (at most `terms.max_amount`) from the payer to
`terms.pay_to` in a single atomic invocation.

Authorization:
- The payer signs `settle(terms)` only, so one signature covers any
amount up to `max_amount`. The payer's authorization tree must also
include the nested `approve` call on the token made below.
- The facilitator signs `settle(terms, actual_amount)`, binding the
exact amount being settled.

Any failure (validation, auth, or token transfer) reverts the whole
invocation, including the inline approval.
function_v0.name: settle
